raidSayLines.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Something moves out there — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
It followed you. The dog-shaped silence at the treeline is here.
It stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. Something displaced a LOT of water is still out there.
⚔️ Caleb killed the dog-shaped silence at the treeline alone — 2 rounds, 46 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.

A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."
